## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests or other verification evidence are included.
- [ ] Secrets, credentials, generated exports, and unrelated changes are absent.
- [ ] Linked issue labels and status have been updated where applicable.
